issues.description: The algorithm stores the earliest prefix sum for each remainder when checking for base segments to be extended by full periods. This maximizes segment_sum = p_r - p_l and can miss valid segments where a later p_l (with the same remainder) would give p_r - p_l <= S. Use the latest prefix (or a structure that can query p_l >= p_r - S) for correctness.

No test files or test harness were delivered to validate the implementation and prevent regressions. Add deterministic tests covering exact matches inside two periods, segments requiring added full periods, the total_sum == 0 case, and large-input edge cases.
